name: Numbered edges + legend
story: Eval case for SKILL.md 'Complex workflows -> Option 2': every edge carries a 1-2 character number and one legend box holds the sentences in narrative order. Exercises the derived legend node (synthesized from `legend`, not a file node) and the numbered callout annotations. Keep the numbers short — mixing numbers and words here defeats the point of the option.

legend.title: What each numbered line means
items: Operational Postgres lands in bronze through Lakeflow Connect.
Documents are uploaded to a governed volume for retrieval.
Bronze is cleaned into silver, then aggregated into gold.
Unity Catalog governs every table, model and agent in one place.
Gold feeds the curated marts the business queries.
Genie answers plain-English questions against the marts.
The dashboard reads governed metric views, not raw tables.
Genie Agent grounds answers in the uploaded documents, via the document volume.
